_about: CC_608 live caption configuration. Edit values below, then run ./demo (or ./start_injector.sh). Keys starting with '_' are documentation only and are ignored by the loader. CLI flags and environment variables override this file when provided.

stream._about: MPEG-TS video path. Injector reads INPUT, writes OUTPUT with captions embedded (H.264 A/53 SEI).

input._description: Source MPEG-TS URL or file. Use UDP multicast/unicast. localaddr must be this machine's NIC IP for multicast.

output._description: Destination MPEG-TS URL or file. Viewers tune this address (e.g. VLC udp://@239.195.11.11:4900) and enable CC1 / DTVCC.

caption_udp._description: Where the injector listens for caption text (plain ASCII UDP lines). 0.0.0.0 accepts LAN senders. demo/live_type/HTTP gateway send here.

captions._about: On-screen caption look and behaviour (passed to cc_injector).

rows._description: Max roll-up window (2..4). Senders use 1–2 lines normally; a 3rd only when the sentence needs more room.

row._description: Vertical screen location (CEA-608 base PAC row). 1 = top, 15 = bottom. Multi-line windows grow upward from this row.

width._description: Max characters per line. CEA-608 hard limit is 32 (YouTube-compatible broadcast width). Longer YouTube overlay lines are word-wrapped to this width (full words kept, not mid-word cut).

timeout_ms._description: Auto-CLEAR idle timeout in milliseconds. After the last caption is sent, wait this long with no new text then erase captions. 0 = never auto-clear.

cc._description: Caption standard to embed. 608 = classic CC1. 708 = DTVCC Service 1 (supports font/pen size). both = 608+708.

font._description: CEA-708 font style (ignored if cc=608). 0=default is the most compatible across VLC/TVs; 1=mono 2=prop 3=mono_sans 4=casual 5=cursive 6=small_caps 7=prop_sans.

pen_size._description: CEA-708 pen / font size (ignored if cc=608). standard is the most compatible; large can clip on some players.

bootstrap._description: If 1, inject a short 'CC ONLINE' caption at start so players expose the CC track quickly.

sei_every._description: Re-insert null CC keep-alive SEI every N video packets while a caption is showing. Higher = less CPU / less risk of flicker. Typical 8..15.

clear_frames._description: How many packets to repeat CLEAR (EDM+row DER) so decoders latch. Typical 4..8 (VLC needs more than 2).

demo._about: Internet caption demo (./demo). Fetches headlines/text and sends them to caption_udp.

host._description: Injector host to send UDP captions to. Use 127.0.0.1 when demo runs on the same machine.

port._description: Injector caption UDP port (must match stream.caption_udp port).

sources._description: List of internet sources. Each URL is auto-detected as RSS/Atom, JSON, or plain text. Override with --source on CLI.

source_type._description: Force source parser, or auto-detect from Content-Type / body.

json_key._description: When source_type is json, field name to collect as caption text (searched recursively).

every._description: Seconds to hold each wrapped caption line on air before the next line.

cps._description: Typing speed in characters per second. 0 = send whole line at once (recommended).

limit._description: Max items to take from each source fetch.

refresh._description: After one full pass of headlines, wait this many seconds then refetch sources.

uppercase._description: If true, force captions to UPPER CASE (classic TV look).

apply_injector._description: If true, ./demo restarts local cc_injector using stream+captions from this file before sending.

send_log._description: Optional path to append each sent caption line (UTC timestamp). Empty string disables logging. Safe for debugging; does not affect on-air output.

web._about: Live monitor page that shows every caption line as it is sent.

port._description: HTTP port for the monitor page (0 = pick a free port). Open http://THIS_HOST:port/

youtube._about: Live YouTube caption ingest (./youtube_cc). Uses yt-dlp to find the stream's WebVTT caption playlist, then polls new cues into the injector. Works only if the live stream has captions / automatic captions.

url._description: YouTube watch URL or video id for the live stream.

lang._description: Caption language code to prefer (e.g. en, ar). Falls back to first available non-chat track.

poll_sec._description: How often to re-check the caption HLS playlist for new WebVTT segments. Use ~1.0 with exact mode for snappier updates.

refresh_playlist_sec._description: How often to re-resolve the playlist URL via yt-dlp (signed URLs expire). Use 60–120 if you see HTTP 403 on segments.

exact._description: EXACT YouTube cue mode (recommended). Shows the same caption block YouTube shows: replace on-screen text with that cue's VTT lines (line breaks preserved, original case). Does NOT mix lines from older cues. If false, re-wrap/roll like a ticker. CEA-608 still max 32 chars/line.

single_upper._description: youtube_eye: true = one caption line on the UPPER row only. false = fill up to captions.rows (recommended 3) with word-wrapped full sentences.

player_delay_sec._description: Seconds behind the caption HLS tip when picking the on-screen cue. Matches typical YouTube player A/V latency so the web/injector text aligns with what you see with CC enabled on youtube.com. Try 6–12 if it still feels early/late.

uppercase._description: Force UPPERCASE in direct/exact mode (default false so text matches YouTube casing).

poll_sec_direct._description: Optional faster poll when exact/direct is true. Ignored if poll_sec is already lower.
